plugin.description: Controls WaveLink Linux (PipeWire mixer) from Stream Deck keys and Stream Deck + dials. WaveLink Linux must be running so the local API on port 24772 is available.

ChannelDial.description: Stream Deck + dial for a WaveLink channel. Turn = volume, press = mute toggle. Choose channel and Monitor/Stream mix in the action settings.

settings.channel: Channel key (system, music, browser, voice, game, sfx, aux, mic, or master).
settings.step: Volume step per dial tick (0.01–0.25, default 0.05).
